name: gan_1um_720C
description: Synthetic 60-minute GaN growth at the provisional operating point (720 C, 1 um/h): heat-up, plasma ignition, growth with both shutters open, N-only droplet consumption, shutdown and cool-down. The performance-gate load case of PHASE1_CHAMBER_PLAN.md section 4 (one Ga cell and the N source; no Al). Not a machine recipe.

steps.name: ramp to growth temperature, plasma on
Ga off, N on (consume excess Ga)
